name: kensho-kclub
description: Read-only MCP server exposing the kensho Japan X/Twitter sweepstakes dataset from kenshou.club (additional sweepstakes source for Kensho collection). Kenshou.club archives tagged with 'twitterで応募' provides 50-200+ sweepstakes entries per run.

input.title: Input schema for kensho-kclub
input.description: kensho-kclub is a read-only MCP server. It requires no input parameters — start it and connect an MCP client to discover its tools. All data is bundled locally; no network, no API key, no account.

output.title: Output schema of kensho-kclub
output.description: kensho-kclub exposes a Streamable HTTP MCP server on the Apify standby container. It produces no dataset or key-value store output; its result is the MCP tool interface itself. Connect an MCP client to the standby URL and call sweepstakes tools.
